document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You trudge on alone. Weary, hungry, footsore, you are blind to 
the bleak splendors of the lonely, remote forests through which 
you pass. You sense your insignificance against the merciless, 
tangled wilderness.
Make a Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 502; if you fail, go to 506.
